study type: secondary analysis of a randomized trial
cohort: 465 Term (≥37 weeks) pregnant women with intact membranes undergoing induction with an unfavorable cervix (Bishop's score ≤6 and dilation ≤2 cm)
finding: Women with obesity undergoing induction are at increased risk of cesarean delivery, even within the context of standardized induction management.
mod_finding: Women with obesity undergoing labor induction had a higher risk of cesarean delivery compared to women without obesity.
